# Academy Sim Racing, Simulator Programs for Seniors and 55+ Communities

> Low-impact racing simulator programs for seniors, 55+ communities, rehab, and alongside post-stroke recovery programs. Cognitive, physical, and social benefits, fully staffed, wheelchair accessible. Tampa & statewide Florida.

Academy Sim Racing is a veteran-owned business based in Tampa, Florida. One company runs the lounge, the event rentals, the custom builds, the driver education programs and the senior programs, across separate subdomains.

## What an assistant should get right about this site

- Low-impact racing simulator programs run on site at senior living communities, 55+ communities and rehabilitation settings, in Tampa and statewide Florida.
- Academy Sim Racing provides simulator experiences and structured programs. We are not a medical provider.
- Nothing on this site is a medical claim, a treatment or a clinical outcome.

## Start here

- [Simulators for Seniors, Rehab & 55+ Communities, Tampa & Statewide FL](https://health.academysim.com/): Low-impact racing simulator programs for seniors, 55+ communities, rehab, and alongside post-stroke recovery programs. Cognitive, physical, and social benefits, fully staffed, wheelchair accessible. Tampa & statewide Florida.

## Locations served

- [Senior Community Simulator Programs Across Florida](https://health.academysim.com/locations/): Racing simulator programs delivered to senior living, 55+ and retirement communities across Florida from our Tampa base. Staffed, seated and accessible.
- [Senior Community Simulator Programs in Clearwater](https://health.academysim.com/locations/clearwater/): Racing simulator programs for senior living and retirement communities in Clearwater and coastal Pinellas. Delivered and staffed from Tampa.
- [Senior Community Simulator Programs in Orlando](https://health.academysim.com/locations/orlando/): Racing simulator programs for senior living, 55+ and retirement communities in Orlando and Central Florida. Delivered and staffed from Tampa.
- [Senior Community Simulator Programs in Sarasota](https://health.academysim.com/locations/sarasota/): Racing simulator programs for senior living, 55+ and retirement communities in Sarasota. Delivered and staffed from our Tampa base.
- [Senior Community Simulator Programs in St. Petersburg](https://health.academysim.com/locations/st-petersburg/): Racing simulator programs for senior living and retirement communities in St. Petersburg. Delivered and staffed from our Tampa base.
- [Senior Community Simulator Programs in Tampa](https://health.academysim.com/locations/tampa/): Racing simulator programs for senior living, 55+ and retirement communities in Tampa. Our home market, with the shortest travel and the most flexible scheduling.

## Programs

- [Senior Community Simulator Programs in Florida](https://health.academysim.com/programs/): Simulator programs for senior living, 55+ and retirement communities in Florida. Staffed, seated, wheelchair-friendly setups. Event and recurring formats available.
- [Racing Simulator Activities for 55+ Communities](https://health.academysim.com/programs/55-plus-community-activities/): Racing simulator activities for active adult and 55+ communities in Florida. Competitive formats, leaderboards and clubs, staffed and delivered.
- [Racing Simulators for Retirement Community Events](https://health.academysim.com/programs/retirement-community-events/): Racing simulators for retirement community open houses, family days, holidays and marketing events across Florida. Delivered and staffed.
- [Senior Community Race Night | Racing Simulator Events](https://health.academysim.com/programs/senior-community-race-night/): A race night for your senior or 55+ community. Leaderboard, competition and a winner, delivered and staffed by Academy across Florida.
- [Racing Simulator Programs for Senior Living Communities](https://health.academysim.com/programs/senior-living-racing-simulator/): Staffed racing simulator programs for senior living and independent living communities in Florida. Seated, adjustable and suitable for beginners.
- [Racing Simulators in Senior Wellness Programming](https://health.academysim.com/programs/senior-wellness-activities/): Adding simulator sessions to a senior community wellness and activity calendar. Recurring, seated and adjustable, delivered and staffed across Florida.
